data.name: Gyanvati
data.gender_notes: Gyanvati is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Gyanvati is a unisex name derived from the Sanskrit word 'gyan', meaning 'knowledge'. It signifies one who bears or carries wisdom and enlightenment. The name Gyanvati carries the meaning “Knowledge bearer” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Gyanvati usually hope their child will grow to embody knowledge bearer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of spiritual wisdom and enlightenment
data.etymology: Gyanvati belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Knowledge bearer.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gyanvati total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
